name: Steam turbines and expanders
applications: mechanical drive of pumps and compressors
principle: A steam turbine extracts thermal energy from pressurised steam in several stages and converts it to shaft work, often driving a generator, pump or compressor.

process_steps.name: Pressurised steam enters through throttle and governor valves
Steam expands through impulse and reaction stages
Exhaust steam condensed or used as process steam
